items.text: What is the most chaotic thing you have ever done in a group chat?
Deliver the weather report as if you are a thunderstorm.
What is the worst text you ever sent to the wrong person?
Speak like a medieval knight until your next turn.
What is the most unhinged thing you have done for a free drink?
Hold a dramatic pose for twenty seconds, chosen by the group.
Who here would be first to start a conga line in a library?
Lead the room in a conga line around the furniture for thirty seconds.
What is the most ridiculous excuse you have used to cancel plans?
Describe the room as if it is a haunted mansion, for thirty seconds.
What is the weirdest food combination you secretly love?
Give the person on your left a fake news report about their morning, kept kind.
What is the strangest thing you have eaten because someone dared you?
Give a motivational speech to an empty chair for thirty seconds.
If you ran the world for one day, what rule would you make first?
Speak only in rhymes until your next turn.
If your life had a theme song, what would it be?
Let the group choose a new name for your character for the rest of the night.
What is the most dramatic reaction you have ever had to something tiny?
Do your best opera singing for ten seconds.
What is the stupidest bet you have ever lost?
Give a wedding toast to the person on your right, even if you barely know them.
What is the worst haircut you have ever had?
Dance like nobody is watching for thirty seconds, then like everybody is.
Which of your habits would get you banned from a library?
Introduce yourself as a famous fictional detective with a made-up catchphrase.
What is the most chaotic group project you have ever been in?
Invent a folk dance and teach it to two people.
What is your most unnecessary purchase this year?
Sing the national anthem of an imaginary country you have just invented.
Have you ever pretended to be someone else for a whole day?
Pretend to be a very dramatic cat demanding dinner.
What is the most confident thing you have said while being completely wrong?
Balance a book on your head while doing five slow squats.
What is the most awkward thing that has happened at a wedding?
Talk in the voice of a sports commentator until your next turn.
Who here would make the best villain in a reality show?
Invent a new emoji with your face and explain what it means.
What is the most absurd excuse you have used for being late?
Stand up and deliver a fake breaking-news alert about the room.
What is the dumbest thing you have ever yelled at a screen?
Compliment every person at the table in one sentence each, in a royal voice.
When have you laughed at the most inappropriate moment?
Swap seats with the person across from you and copy their posture for two minutes.
If you were a villain, what would your evil plan be?
Have a sword fight with an invisible enemy, with huge dramatic gestures.
What is the most spectacular fail you have ever filmed?
Pretend to be a waiter and recite a made-up menu with great pride.
Who here would be the first to get lost in IKEA?
Lead the group in a three-note chant until everyone can do it.
What is your most dramatic exit line?
Talk like a superhero announcer until your next turn.
What would your superhero name and useless power be?
Reveal a secret talent in ten seconds, with a drumroll from the group.
Have you ever ruined a surprise? What did you do?
Speak every sentence like a Shakespearean actor until your next turn.
What is the most chaotic thing you have done in a supermarket?
Give a dramatic, slow-motion pep talk to the snack table.
What is the worst prank you pulled that backfired on you?
Make the most dramatic sigh you can, then explain it in a five-word sentence.
